content.text: - Verify `getValueAsString()` returns correct current text for a scalar XML element (e.g. `value`), matching `getText()`. - Check `getValueAsString(String defaultValue)` returns the actual text when current token has text, not the default. - Check default fallback is returned only when no current text is available (e.g. on START_OBJECT/END_OBJECT tokens without text), both single-arg (null) and default-arg variants. - Confirm behavior on empty XML element (`` or ``) — text should be empty string, not null/default, per XML module contract (`_isEmpty` logic). - Confirm behavior at `VALUE_NULL` token if XML signals null via xsi:nil — getValueAsString should return default/null appropriately. - Confirm getText() and getValueAsString() stay consistent across repeated calls without advancing token (idempotent). - Boundary: calling getValueAsString before first nextToken() call (parser positioned before any token) should not throw and should follow defaultValue contract. - Ensure receiver setup: build XMLStreamReader from simple XML string, wrap into FromXmlParser via XmlFactory/XmlMapper to get real token stream rather than mocks. - Test nested element with attribute-only content (no text) returns default, not attribute value. - Test after consuming END_DOCUMENT/close(), getValueAsString does not throw unexpected exceptions (may throw IOException per contract if closed).
